allOf.description: An agency is a standard tenant type within the Zywave platform and represents an insurance agency or related entity.

id.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the agency.

AgencyInfo.description: AgencyInfo represents the editable properties of an agency.

address.description: The primary address for the agency.

alias.description: An abbreviated or informal name of the agency.

city.description: The city of the primary address for the agency.

countryCode.description: The country of the primary address for the agency.

isEnabled.description: Determines whether the agency is an active agency. If the agency is not active they will not have access to functionality throughout the Zywave platform.

faxNumber.description: The fax number for the agency.

name.description: The primary name that is used to identify the agency.

organizationalUnitId.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the organization unit that the agency belongs to.

organizationId.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the organization that the agency belongs to.

parentId.description: The unique Zywave identifier for a parent agency if this is a child agency.

phoneNumber.description: The primary phone number for the agency.

postalCode.description: The zip code or postal code of the primary address for the agency.

subdivisionCode.description: The state or province of the primary address for the agency.
